boundaries.native: Four independent native Cocoa/Flutter Debug App processes with actual SQLCipher, production Owner adapters/approval controls, inherited-sandbox AOT CLI and native PDF channel. Unique synthetic App identity and fixed synthetic database keys.
boundaries.backup: Source exports actual full encrypted backup with separately saved synthetic recovery material; empty restored library uses a different database key. Reopen/restore deny previous active bearer and session, do not recreate copies, keep exact version/delivery facts. Portable restore excludes local operation receipts and runtime leases.
boundaries.package: Full ARM64 release, 20 build/extract phases, six extracted CLI/worker tests, actual SQLCipher diagnostic, ad-hoc, no notarization. Source checks not rerun during package; production source identical to previously tested M07 and this native QA.
boundaries.notDone: Actual shipped normal-entry GUI with outside-package CLI and a real AI file chat; system panels/default receiver, personal upgrade/Keychain and final installation remain separately unverified.
boundaries.cleanup: One primary unpacked candidate plus ZIP retained. Packaging clone, verification duplicate App, diagnostic build and dSYMs removed. Native source/App/dSYM/derived trees and marked synthetic fixture removed; fixed preview untouched.
boundaries.privacy: No personal library, Keychain, CUA, global hooks or Windows CI. Private synthetic bearer/session/recovery remained in 0700 fixture/0600 state and were removed, never exported to evidence.
